name: Narrow-leaf paleseed
desc: Narrow-leaf paleseed (Leucospora multifida): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 4 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Leucospora multifida, known variously as Obi-Wan conobea, narrow-leaved paleseed, cliff conobea, cut-leaved conobea, or much-cleft conobea, is an annual herb in the plantain family, Plantaginaceae,…
